artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan covering only the residual work after the research dispatch's committed sweep: verify the landed repairs, triage the checker's 105 findings into four decided classes, repair the genuine phantom docs/ citations, and absorb non-defect findings into the checker's allowlists.

memory_candidates.content: When a research dispatch performs and commits direct repair work (not just investigation), the following plan dispatch must re-verify the LANDED TREE rather than planning from the research report's prose. The phantom-citation sweep's research dispatch committed the entire named repair set plus a new checker script; planning from its report alone would have re-planned nine already-repaired instances. The cheap, reliable verification is `git show --stat <research commit>` for the touched-file list, plus re-running whatever mechanical checker the research dispatch built and diffing against its reported counts. The same pattern identifies what genuinely remains: the research report's own 'follow-up work, not performed in this dispatch' sentences are the plan's actual scope.
